Name: Poise Pressure
Trigger: A qualifying Force impact, or a Static hit explicitly carrying Poise
Effect: One shared bar (11.2); at full, a brief stagger or interrupt
Counterplay and limit: Not every hit adds Poise; drains after a spell without qualifying hits; elites and bosses have bigger bars and shorter staggers, never full immunity
Distinction: Force adds by impact; Static only when an attack explicitly carries Poise or interruption pressure

Name: Knockback
Effect: Repositions the target; a collision may add a payoff
Counterplay and limit: Space, Squishy, an active Membrane, anchoring; bonus only on an actual collision
Starting values: Distance = impulse ÷ (radius ÷ 12); hitting a wall deals 40% of the hit

Name: Corrosion
Trigger: Acid hits, or standing in an Acid Pool
Effect: A visible bar (11.2). On a Shell creature, a full bar strips one layer for good and resets. Any creature can carry it; it is the "Acid-coated" state reactions use
Counterplay and limit: No timer or stacks; no damage over time
Distinction: Acid's only status; Pools are its only ongoing damage
Starting values: Bar size 0.25 of max health per Shell layer, and as one layer on a creature with no Shell (11.2); a full bar strips one layer for good and resets, or with no Shell makes the creature Corroded for 4 s (decision 34). No damage over time

Name: Charge
Effect: The target is Charged (3 s): it takes +20% Static damage and passes arcs on; it discharges one arc on death
Counterplay and limit: Fixed jump limit (3) and 70% falloff; never interrupts by itself
Distinction: A conductor state, not a build-up bar; interrupts come through Poise
Starting values: A Static hit makes the target Charged for 3 s (Static hits refresh it). Charged enemies take +20% Static damage and pass arcs on: 3 jumps, range 110, each jump 70% of the last. A Charged enemy discharges one arc when it dies. Charge itself never interrupts; interrupts come through Poise

Name: Snared
Trigger: A Mucus hit, or entering a Mucus patch
Effect: Restricts movement (also covers "Mucus-stuck" and "Adhered"). Becoming Snared clears a Burn bar: Mucus smothers Fire
Counterplay and limit: Short duration; one clear control strength per effect
Distinction: Slow, root and snare are not interchangeable labels
Starting values: 55% slow for 2.5 s; refreshes on hit; clears a Burn bar

Name: Conjoined
Trigger: Two Snared creatures touch, or one Mucus attack's area covers several at once
Effect: Stuck together in one shared green membrane: none can move, and they may hit each other
Distinction: Distinct from Snared: it needs two or more creatures
Starting values: 3 s stuck; max 6 per group; members' contact deals 50% to each other. On the player: 1 s stuck, no enemy attached

Name: Bleed
Effect: Damage over time; a reaction may consume it for one payoff
Counterplay and limit: Stack cap and decay. A creature that dies while bleeding leaves a small blood pool
Distinction: Wounds are distinct from Acid erosion
Starting values: 30% of the hit over 3 s; max 3 stacks

Name: Extraction
Counterplay and limit: 1% of max health per kill, max 6 health per second; never on every Blood tick
Distinction: Separate from ordinary damage and healing
Starting values: An enemy dying while bleeding heals you 1% of max health; max 6 health per second

Name: Possessed
Effect: The enemy fights its own mates for a few seconds
Counterplay and limit: Clear duration and tell; cooldown before it can repeat; elites shorter; bosses reduced, never fully controlled; the player is exempt
Distinction: The only control Soul owns; not Fear
Starting values: 4 s, then 8 s before it can happen again (elites 2.5 s; bosses 1.5 s, lashing out at adds once). It targets the nearest enemy; its attacks and contact hurt enemies, not you; nearby enemies fight back; your weapons skip it; its kills give you XP; with no enemy near, it wanders harmlessly. The player is exempt

Name: Fear
Owner or source: Peekaboo's BOO; a future Feat ("Jump Scare")
Trigger: An attack explicitly tagged with Fear
Counterplay and limit: Duration cap; no enemy applies Fear
Distinction: Fear is a status, not the Soul type itself
Starting values: Enemies flee for 2 s. Sources: Peekaboo's BOO, and a future player Feat, "Jump Scare". No enemy applies it

Name: Burning
Trigger: Fire hits, or standing in a Fire Pool footprint
Effect: A visible Burn bar (11.2); while it holds Burn the target takes a short damage over time; at full, Ignition: one flare on that target, then the bar resets
Counterplay and limit: No spread except through reactions; Snared puts it out
Distinction: Do not add extra effects to every Fire hit
Starting values: One shared burn per target (decision 36): each Fire hit adds 20% of its damage and refreshes the 3 s timer; at most 50% of max health held; Ignition at full bar

Name: Acid Pool
Owner or source: Acid Pool weapon, Acid Bubble, Slick Move, acid crypts (terrain)
Effect: The only ongoing Acid damage; builds Corrosion on anything standing in it
Counterplay and limit: Visible edge and lifetime; never indefinite
Starting values: Radius 58, lifetime 3.5 s; Matches the v10 Pool weapon

Name: Mucus patch
Owner or source: Mucus Pool weapon, Snot Bubble, Snot Rocket
Effect: Snares what enters it; ingredient for Slick Move, Sticky Situation, Flammable Mucus

Name: Blood pool
Owner or source: Creatures dying while bleeding; Blood Pool weapon; Mosquito
Effect: Ingredient for Blood Circuit and Caught in the Clot

Name: Terrain (shipped, terrain.js)
Effect: Nodules, mitochondria, acid crypts, cilia beds, currents and slicks keep their current behaviour

Name: Wax Pool
Effect: Hardens into a temporary wall that blocks movement and shots
Counterplay and limit: The one new ground object; short-lived
Starting values: Size about 60 long, lifetime 6 s; Blocks movement and shots both ways; about 30 health (shots chip it); autoaim skips targets behind it unless a Beam or Burst can reach; max 2 per Candle
